401:  *  POST is tiny JSON (a few hundred bytes). The cap is a defense against a
402:  *  pathological/malicious client; legitimate proxy traffic doesn't hit these
403:  *  routes. */
404: async function readRequestBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<string> {
405:   const MAX = 1024 * 1024;
406:   let bytes = 0;
407:   const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
408:   for await (const chunk of req) {
409:     const b = chunk as Buffer;
410:     bytes += b.byteLength;
411:     if (bytes > MAX) throw new Error('request body too large');
412:     chunks.push(b);
413:   }
414:   return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
415: }

417: function isLoopbackAddress(address: string | undefined): boolean {

539:             on = j.on === true;

581: /**
582:  * Append-only JSONL tracker with size-based rotation. One line per request.
583:  *
584:  * Node-only — uses node:fs. The Worker host uses tracker.JsonLogTracker with
585:  * console.log instead (Cloudflare ingests that as Workers Logs).
586:  *
587:  * Rotation: when the current file exceeds MAX_FILE_BYTES (100 MB by default),
588:  * it's renamed to `<path>.1` (overwriting any previous .1) and a fresh file
589:  * is opened. Keeps one generation of history; for longer retention pipe
590:  * the file off-host yourself.
591:  *
592:  * Failures here NEVER propagate — the proxy must keep serving requests even
593:  * if the disk is full or the path is unwritable.
594:  */
595: class FileTracker implements Tracker {
596:   private fd: number | null = null;
597:   private bytesWritten = 0;
598:   private brokenLogged = false;
599:   private static readonly MAX_FILE_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
600: 
601:   constructor(private readonly filePath: string) {}
602: 
603:   private ensureOpen(): boolean {
604:     if (this.fd != null) return true;
605:     try {
606:       const parent = path.dirname(this.filePath);
607:       const parentExists = fs.existsSync(parent);
608:       fs.mkdirSync(parent, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
609:       if (!parentExists) fs.chmodSync(parent, 0o700);
610:     } catch {
611:       /* dir may already exist or be unmkable; openSync below will surface */
612:     }
613:     try {
614:       const st = fs.statSync(this.filePath);
615:       this.bytesWritten = st.size;
616:     } catch {
617:       this.bytesWritten = 0;
618:     }
619:     try {
620:       this.fd = fs.openSync(this.filePath, 'a', 0o600);
621:       fs.chmodSync(this.filePath, 0o600);
622:       return true;
623:     } catch (err) {
624:       if (!this.brokenLogged) {
625:         console.error(
626:           `[pxpipe] FileTracker disabled — cannot open ${this.filePath}: ${(err as Error).message}`,
627:         );
628:         this.brokenLogged = true;
629:       }
630:       return false;
631:     }
632:   }
633: 
634:   private rotate(): void {
635:     if (this.fd != null) {
636:       try {
637:         fs.closeSync(this.fd);
638:       } catch {
639:         /* ignore */
640:       }
641:       this.fd = null;
642:     }
643:     try {
644:       fs.renameSync(this.filePath, this.filePath + '.1');
645:     } catch {
646:       /* if rename fails (e.g. .1 locked) we'll just keep growing — better
647:          than dropping events */
648:     }
649:     this.bytesWritten = 0;
650:   }
651: 
652:   emit(ev: TrackEvent): void {
653:     if (!this.ensureOpen()) return;
654:     try {
655:       const line = JSON.stringify(ev) + '\n';
656:       const buf = Buffer.from(line, 'utf8');
657:       fs.writeSync(this.fd!, buf);
658:       this.bytesWritten += buf.length;
659:       if (this.bytesWritten > FileTracker.MAX_FILE_BYTES) this.rotate();
660:     } catch (err) {
661:       if (!this.brokenLogged) {
662:         console.error(
663:           `[pxpipe] FileTracker write failed: ${(err as Error).message}`,
664:         );
665:         this.brokenLogged = true;
666:       }
667:     }
668:   }
669: 
670:   flush(): void {
671:     if (this.fd != null) {
672:       try {
673:         fs.fsyncSync(this.fd);
674:       } catch {
675:         /* ignore */
676:       }
677:     }
678:   }
679: 
680:   close(): void {
681:     if (this.fd != null) {
682:       try {
683:         fs.fsyncSync(this.fd);
684:       } catch {
685:         /* ignore */
686:       }
687:       try {
688:         fs.closeSync(this.fd);
689:       } catch {
690:         /* ignore */
691:       }
692:       this.fd = null;
693:     }
694:   }
695: }

699: /**
700:  * For oversized 4xx body samples that won't fit inline in the JSONL row, we
701:  * write them to a sidecar file at `<dir>/${ts}-${sha8}.json.gz`. The path
702:  * lands in the event as `req_body_sample_path`. Survives log rotation and
703:  * stays out of the streaming dashboard.
704:  *
705:  * Failure mode: directory unwritable or write fails → returns undefined and
706:  * the body sample is silently dropped (we still keep the sha8 and error_body
707:  * for diagnostics; the request itself was never blocked by this).
708:  */
709: async function maybeWriteBodySidecar(
710:   bytesGz: Uint8Array,
711:   sha8: string | undefined,
712:   dir: string,
713: ): Promise<string | undefined> {
714:   try {
715:     // Lazy mkdir — only when we actually need to write.
716:     ensurePrivateDirectory(dir);
717:   } catch {
718:     return undefined;
719:   }
720:   // Filename: timestamp + sha8 keeps collisions effectively impossible and
721:   // makes the file naturally sortable. Sha8 fallback covers the edge case
722:   // where the hash wasn't computed (zero-byte body, etc.).
723:   const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
724:   const tag = sha8 ?? 'nohash';
725:   const filePath = path.join(dir, `${ts}-${tag}.json.gz`);
726:   try {
727:     await fs.promises.writeFile(filePath, bytesGz, { mode: 0o600 });
728:     await fs.promises.chmod(filePath, 0o600);
729:     return filePath;
730:   } catch {
731:     return undefined;
732:   }
733: }

782: /** Directories never descended into when walking files. */
783: const WALK_SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
784:   'node_modules', '.git', '.svn', '.hg', 'dist', 'build',
785:   '__pycache__', '.cache', '.next', '.nuxt', '.turbo',
786: ]);

788: interface CollectedFile {
789:   relPath: string;
790:   content: string;
791: }

793: /** Recursively walk a directory, collecting text files that pass include/exclude filters. */
794: function walkDir(
795:   dir: string,
796:   rootDir: string,
797:   include: string[],
798:   exclude: string[],
799:   out: CollectedFile[],
800: ): void {
801:   let entries: fs.Dirent[];
802:   try {
803:     entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
804:   } catch {
805:     return;
806:   }
807:   for (const entry of entries) {
808:     const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
809:     const rel = path.relative(rootDir, full).replace(/\\/g, '/');
810:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
811:       if (WALK_SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;
812:       walkDir(full, rootDir, include, exclude, out);
813:     } else if (entry.isFile()) {
814:       // Bulk directory walk: skip silently on any gate miss (per-file warnings
815:       // would be noise across a whole tree).
816:       const r = readExportTextFile(full, rel, include, exclude);
817:       if (r.kind === 'ok') out.push({ relPath: rel, content: r.content });
818:     }
819:   }
820: }

822: /** Collect files from a list of targets (files or directories). */
823: function collectFilesFromTargets(
824:   targets: string[],
825:   include: string[],
826:   exclude: string[],
827: ): CollectedFile[] {
828:   const files: CollectedFile[] = [];
829:   for (const target of targets) {
830:     let st: fs.Stats;
831:     try { st = fs.statSync(target); } catch {
832:       console.warn(`[pxpipe export] skipping inaccessible target: ${target}`);
833:       continue;
834:     }
835:     if (st.isDirectory()) {
836:       walkDir(target, target, include, exclude, files);
837:     } else if (st.isFile()) {
838:       const rel = path.basename(target);
839:       const r = readExportTextFile(target, rel, include, exclude);
840:       if (r.kind === 'ok') files.push({ relPath: rel, content: r.content });
841:       else if (r.kind !== 'excluded') {
842:         console.warn(`[pxpipe export] skipping ${r.kind} file: ${target}`);
843:       }
844:     }
845:   }
846:   return files;
847: }

849: /** Run a git command in `cwd`, return stdout string or null on failure. */

851:   const result = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
852:   if (result.status !== 0 || result.error) return null;

856: /** Collect source text for the export run. Returns [sourceText, sourceFiles[]] */
857: async function collectSource(opts: ExportParsed): Promise<[string, string[]]> {
858:   // --stdin
859:   if (opts.stdin) {
860:     const chunks: string[] = [];
861:     process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');
862:     for await (const chunk of process.stdin) {
863:       if (typeof chunk === 'string') chunks.push(chunk);
864:     }
865:     return [chunks.join(''), []];
866:   }
867: 
868:   // --diff <ref>
869:   if (opts.diff !== undefined) {
870:     const cwd = opts.targets.length > 0 ? opts.targets[0]! : process.cwd();
871:     const diff = gitRun(['diff', opts.diff], cwd);
872:     if (diff === null) {
873:       console.error(`[pxpipe export] git diff ${opts.diff} failed`);
874:       process.exit(1);
875:     }
876:     return [diff, []];
877:   }
878: 
879:   // --git
880:   if (opts.git) {
881:     const cwd = opts.targets.length > 0 ? opts.targets[0]! : process.cwd();
882:     const diff = gitRun(['diff', 'HEAD'], cwd) ?? '';
883:     // Collect untracked files
884:     const untrackedOut = gitRun(['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd) ?? '';
885:     const untrackedFiles = untrackedOut
886:       .split('\n')
887:       .map((l) => l.trim())
888:       .filter(Boolean);
889:     let untracked = '';
890:     for (const rel of untrackedFiles) {
891:       const full = path.join(cwd, rel);
892:       // Same include/exclude + size + binary gate as directory mode. Untracked
893:       // files previously bypassed all of it: --include/--exclude were ignored
894:       // and an oversized file was read fully into memory.
895:       const r = readExportTextFile(full, rel, opts.include, opts.exclude);
896:       if (r.kind === 'ok') untracked += `\n===== ${rel} =====\n` + r.content;
897:       else if (r.kind !== 'excluded') {
898:         console.warn(`[pxpipe export] skipping ${r.kind} untracked file: ${rel}`);
899:       }
900:     }
901:     const sourceText = diff + untracked;
902:     return [sourceText, []];
903:   }
904: 
905:   // File/directory mode (default)
906:   const targets = opts.targets.length > 0 ? opts.targets : ['.'];
907:   const files = collectFilesFromTargets(targets, opts.include, opts.exclude);
908:   if (files.length === 0) {
909:     console.warn('[pxpipe export] no files collected');
910:   }
911:   const sourceText = files
912:     .map((f) => `===== ${f.relPath} =====\n${f.content}`)
913:     .join('\n\n');
914:   const sourceFiles = files.map((f) => f.relPath);
915:   return [sourceText, sourceFiles];
916: }

972: async function runExport(argv: string[]): Promise<void> {
973:   const parseResult = parseExportArgv(argv);

975:   if (parseResult.kind === 'help') {

977:     process.exit(0);

981:     console.error(`[pxpipe export] run \`pxpipe export --help\` for usage`);
982:     process.exit(2);

985:   const opts = parseResult.parsed;

987:   // Collect source text
988:   const [sourceText, sourceFiles] = await collectSource(opts);
